name: NAAIL OpenLab
description: An evidence-governed, human-led AI platform for business-school education, Audit Digital Twins, multi-agent audit simulation, and reproducible scientific discovery. Version 0.2.2 advances the public Audit Digital Twin program to Prototype 002 with a modular synthetic revenue-recognition benchmark, Evidence Passport and Professional Decision DAG concepts, provider-neutral model comparison, reproducibility tests, and a mandatory Human Gate.
